This bug also applies to 3.0b1 & trunk.
It's a straightforward fix, but I think this will wait till after the 3.0b1 release.
Leaving this open till fixes get merged into trunk and maintenance-2.2
After the last fix, when I try to install with FEDORA_HOME containing a space, I get the following, similar error (notice this time it's caused by WebXML instead of FedoraUsers).

I've applied the fixes thus far to maintenance-2.2 and trunk, but I'm leaving this one open 'till it's fully addressed.  If the WebXML fix is as simple as the FedoraUsers one, after testing locally you can just make the change to maintenance-2.2 and trunk directly.  After doing this please note the revs here.
fixes to WebXML in trunk (r6639) and maintenance-2.2 (r6638)
On Windows, the installer fails if FEDORA_HOME contains a space, e.g. FEDORA_HOME=C:\Program Files\fedora
